items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You’re not talking about Eric Dolphy? INTERVIEWEE: Yes I am.

ctx.x: No. No now even the club actually there were — there is one name that I don’t have over here, the flute player would come in actually and he would play and that would be — and he wouldn’t be able to do anything that Trane did actually. It was a little embarrassing.
You’re not talking about Eric Dolphy?
